note: Original silhouette studies. All prints are labeled placeholders until real Color Me Art files land in designs/artwork/. All prices DRAFT.

concepts.name: The 313
concepts.changes: The flagship: espresso pebble body, black trim, gold chain.
concepts.why: Every line needs a north star. This is the everyday one — the bag that goes to work, to dinner, to the airport.
concepts.speaks: The area code you carry. Detroit luxury that doesn't ask permission.

concepts.name: Midnight on Woodward
concepts.changes: Taller, slimmer, noir-on-noir with silver chain and a thinner strap.
concepts.why: Every collection needs its after-dark piece. Slimming the profile and cooling the hardware turns the same crescent formal.
concepts.speaks: Date night downtown. Streetlights on the avenue. The one that goes with everything because it argues with nothing.
concepts.mood: moody after-dark editorial, cool light, black-on-black tonality

concepts.name: Cognac Hour
concepts.changes: Wider and low-slung, cognac body over chocolate trim, wider strap, softer grain.
concepts.why: Stretching the crescent horizontal makes it lounge instead of stand — the silhouette itself relaxes.
concepts.speaks: Golden hour, brass instruments, velvet booths. Vintage soul glamour, poured slow.
concepts.mood: golden-hour glow, jazz lounge warmth, amber tones

concepts.name: Belle Isle
concepts.changes: Compact body, deep emerald over cream trim — the first two-tone flip.
concepts.why: Pairing a jewel green with cream trim reads garden party, not office. Smaller scale makes it a companion, not cargo.
concepts.speaks: Sunday on the island. The conservatory's green glass. A picnic that dresses up.
concepts.mood: fresh daylight, botanical garden airiness, jewel green

concepts.name: Spirit
concepts.changes: Tall proud profile in verdigris patina green with antique gold.
concepts.why: The tall build carries the color like a monument carries weather. Patina green only works at scale — so we gave it scale.
concepts.speaks: The statue downtown holding the sun in one hand and the people in the other. Monumental optimism you can wear.
concepts.mood: monumental, bronze-patina, civic pride, warm stone light

concepts.name: Eastern Market Saturday
concepts.changes: The big one — roomy market-day scale, cream canvas body wearing a produce-and-flowers print, tan trim.
concepts.why: Flower Day demands room. The print carries the color so the body can be calm cream underneath it.
concepts.speaks: Shed 2 on a Saturday morning: tomatoes, marigolds, murals. Art you can carry groceries past.
concepts.mood: sunny market morning, fresh produce palette, mural energy

concepts.name: Riverwalk Blues
concepts.changes: Standard body gone deep navy, wave-form blues print, navy trim, silver chain.
concepts.why: One print concept should move instead of bloom — waves and waveforms in the same gesture, because this city gave the world its pulse.
concepts.speaks: The river at dusk. Techno's heartbeat. Motion in blue.
concepts.mood: dusk riverside, electric blue accents, rhythmic and cool

concepts.name: Grandma's Sunday Best
concepts.changes: The petite one: cream body, deep berry trim, delicate strap, small gold chain.
concepts.why: Shrinking every dimension at once changes the bag's posture — it sits upright, formal, held not slung.
concepts.speaks: The matriarchs. White gloves, pressed collars, a pew saved for you. Dignity as fashion, passed down.
concepts.mood: soft morning light, heirloom elegance, cream and berry

concepts.name: The Muralist
concepts.changes: Charcoal body as the wall; a full-bleed bold print as the mural; blacked-out hardware so nothing competes.
concepts.why: This is Erika artist-first. Everything else on the bag steps back so the artwork is the entire statement.
concepts.speaks: Color Me Art at architectural scale. The bag as her canvas — every drop a new wall.
concepts.mood: gallery lighting, bold contemporary art, charcoal backdrop

concepts.name: First Snow on Second Ave
concepts.changes: Plush deep body in winter white with ice-gray trim and silver — the softest grain in the line.
concepts.why: A white bag in a northern city is a flex. The deeper gusset and soft grain make it read plush, like fresh snowfall.
concepts.speaks: The first quiet snow, before the plows. Detroit winters worn proudly, not endured.
concepts.mood: winter morning softness, high-key light, quiet luxury
